definitions.short: Galed , a memorial cairn East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1567. Galed גַּלְעֵד proper name, of a location ( witness-pile ) name of pile of stones erected by Jacob and his company (Kit Geschichte.129 ; by Laban We Di) Gen 31:47-48 , (see גַּל 1c ) apparently intended to explain גִּלְעָד q. v.; Di conjecture also (as name of altar) Josh 22:34 (compare ᵑ6 ).
